summary: Enhance your understanding of Humanitarian Law with our comprehensive training course. Gain essential skills and knowledge to navigate complex legal frameworks.
lede: Humanitarian law and policy examines the rules and operational choices that shape protection and assistance during armed conflict. Designed for protection officers, policy advisers, programme managers and legal advisers, it helps translate those obligations into informed operational decisions. Learners practise classifying conflict situations, assessing civilian protection risks, reviewing access and programme choices, documenting escalation decisions, and communicating obligations to stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who interpret, implement, supervise, or advise on humanitarian law and policy in conflict-affected and high-risk operating environments.
modules: Humanitarian Law Foundations and Conflict Context
Digital Evidence and Humanitarian Data Workflows
prerequisites: No law degree or prior humanitarian law certification is required. You should have basic familiarity with humanitarian programmes, emergency response, public policy, security operations, or international affairs. You will work with case materials and digital templates, so a laptop is useful, but coding or programming is not required. Advanced subjects such as accountability mechanisms, digital evidence, and AI-assisted incident triage are taught at conceptual awareness and operational application levels, not technical engineering level.
